stories.headline: OpenAI resumes training after security overhaul
stories.summary: OpenAI resumed frontier-model training after barring internet access and strengthening containment. External evaluators found monitoring gaps; OpenAI says it patched them, but the evaluators have not verified the fixes.

stories.headline: US proposes wider China tech-investment curbs
stories.summary: The US proposed adding biotechnology and expanding restrictions covering advanced computing and hypersonics. China called the measures discriminatory and threatened unspecified countermeasures; the rules are not final.

stories.headline: Michigan Senate race draws Trump and Obama
stories.summary: Trump campaigns in Michigan one day after Obama as a competitive open-seat Senate race could help determine chamber control. Claims linking Democrat Abdul El-Sayed to the Muslim Brotherhood lack evidence and are denied.

stories.headline: US officials accused of influencing Brazil vote
stories.summary: Ten current and former officials told Reuters that two State Department advisers pushed measures favoring Brazil's Bolsonaro camp. Reuters could not determine whether they acted on White House or secretary-level orders.

stories.headline: US–Ukraine rift deepens over energy strikes
stories.summary: Ukraine's attacks on Russian fuel infrastructure have widened tensions with Trump amid high energy prices. Kyiv and a US official dispute whether Washington threatened intelligence support; peace talks remain inconclusive.
